NEVER edit/create/delete/move anything under /opt/nxeon; NEVER run npm/npx/prisma/build/db/service commands. Do not touch /opt/nxeon-staging or /opt/nxeon-sandbox. The ONLY file you may write: /tmp/claude-0/-root/4f329df3-66ee-49c8-a6c5-615ecf189efc/scratchpad/report-assets.md
Read the brief first: /tmp/claude-0/-root/4f329df3-66ee-49c8-a6c5-615ecf189efc/scratchpad/brief-full.md (sections 11, 12, 13, 14, 54, 55, 57 most relevant).

SCOPE — inventory EVERY existing visual asset used by the customer portal and decide, per asset/asset-class, a category of KEEP / REWORK / REPLACE / REMOVE with a one-line rationale. Per the brief, the default for decorative assets is REPLACE; only assets explicitly justified as part of the future brand system get KEEP.

Cover:
1. public/ — every directory: games/ (110 files: hero/poster/logo conventions — read the naming convention and the metadata that maps games to art, e.g. lib/game-meta* or wherever GAME_META lives; note sizes/dimensions/format/quality; note licensing posture: are these official game artworks? where sourced? flag risk), logos/ (67: OS/app/brand logos — which are simple-icons vs custom PNG/SVG; consistency of style/size/background), flags/ (110: format, source, usage — where flags are rendered), marketing/ (6), blog/ (12), riddle/, dl/, novnc/ (vendored — note but don't audit), top-level logo.png / nx-mark.png / favicon.svg / icon-192/512 / apple-touch-icon / maintenance.html. Give dimensions and file sizes (use `identify` if ImageMagick exists, else `file`).
2. LOGO TREATMENTS: how the Nxeon logo/wordmark/mark is rendered in the portal Shell (components/portal/Shell.tsx), auth pages (components/marketing/AuthShell.tsx), emails, favicon; sizes; the "OPS"/"STAFF" tag; consistency.
3. INLINE / CODE-DRAWN GRAPHICS in the customer portal: decorative backgrounds (grep for hero-aura, AmbientField, tone-*, radial-gradient, blur-3xl, "glow", "aura", noise, grid backgrounds, canvas particle animations), illustrations/empty-state art, region maps/globes (components using d3-geo + public/countries-110m.json — NetworkMap, SingaporeNetworkMap, Region Globe/Picker etc.), the showcase mock screens in components/marketing/showcase/* (are any used inside the dashboard?), deployment/provisioning animations, the free-Minecraft preloader (components/customer/FreeMinecraftLoader.tsx). For each: file, what it draws, where used, category verdict.
4. ICONS: catalogue how icons are produced — the `icons` map in components/portal/Shell.tsx (list every key), inline SVGs scattered in components/customer/**, simple-icons usage (which brands), emoji used as icons (grep for emoji chars in tsx), any icon library imports. Count distinct inline icon SVGs, note viewBox/stroke-width/size variance — this substantiates the "icon soup" problem.
5. IMAGE TREATMENT conventions: aspect ratios used for game cards/heroes, `object-cover` crops, gradient overlays, per-product colors (grep for per-product color maps like PRODUCT_COLORS / game accent colors), OS/app logo presentation in the deploy wizard.
6. A summary table: asset class → count → current quality/consistency → verdict → what the NEW asset language would need instead (just the requirement, e.g. "custom Nxeon product icon set, 24px grid, 1.5px stroke", not the design itself).

Write the report file, then return a ~300-word summary + the report path.
